title: Internal: Resetting or Changing a Debit Card PIN
summary: This document explains how to reset or change a debit card PIN, covering verification requirements, eligible card statuses (ACTIVE only), immediate effectiveness, and what to do for locked cards after 3 incorrect PIN entries. It details PIN rules (exactly 4 digits; not sequential; not all same digit; not birth year/month/day) and the procedures using reset_debit_card_pin_6284 or change_debit_card_pin_6285.
